name: pyhouse-universal
description: Python house-style rules that bind whichever architecture a service uses: naming derivation, typing and logging forms, the package and re-export contract, settings read from the environment, the data-access obligations every store meets, the lint, type-check and dependency configuration every distribution carries once, the single error catalogue, what a distribution's version promises and which change moves it, the testing constitution, and the workspace root for a repository holding several distributions. Ships the hex-vs-flat architecture chooser and its /choose-architecture command, so a greenfield service can settle its family before installing pyhouse-hex or pyhouse-flat, and the namespaced /pyhouse-universal:code-review command with the reviewer subagent behind it, which applies these skills to existing code instead of writing new code.
